checks.explanation: ChatGPT passed the 1 billion monthly/weekly active user mark within a couple of months of this prediction (episode published late March 2026) - reporting places the milestone around May-June 2026, consistent with Jason's 'next month or two' timeframe from the ~900 million figure cited on the show.

checks.explanation: ChatGPT's market share fell below 50% for the first time in June 2026, reaching 46.4% by May 2026 as Gemini (27.7%) and Claude (10.3%) gained ground, confirming Jason's prediction that ChatGPT would end up well under 50% market share as Apple, Meta, and other players entered.
